title: A Millimetre Over the Line
setup: December 1, 2022, World Cup group stage, Japan against Spain. In the 51st minute Kaoru Mitoma chases a ball near the goal line and cuts it back, and Ao Tanaka scores. The on-field decision is that the ball had gone out of play, so there is no goal. VAR checks the goal-line camera.
question: What does the VAR review decide?
options: The ball was out. No goal.
The play is restarted with a drop ball.
ruling: VAR official Fernando Guerrero overturned the on-field decision because the goal-line camera showed part of the ball still over the line. The goal stood, Japan won 2-1, and the goal eliminated Germany from the tournament.
rulebookNote: For VAR to overturn the call, there must be definitive evidence that part of the ball is on the line. Even a very small overhang counts, not just the ball touching the ground.
